turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
ore help picking out your starter kit!
How do I use it properly the very first time?
For your first use:



Place the warmer on a safe, flat surface and plug it in.


Add wax melts:


Mini Mod/Outlet: start with 1–2 bears


Signature/Mod: 2–3 bears


Mod Max: 5–8 bears


Turn it on or set the timer.


If there’s no timer, set your own and keep an eye on it.



As a general guideline, 2 bears provide about 8 hours of scent time.
If you have any other questions or need more tips, just let me know!
